title: cheilanthes farinosa var. sulphurea
intro: Cheilanthes farinosa var. sulphurea, commonly known as Sulphur Spleenwort, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of non-vascular plant that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Sulphur Spleenwort include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Sulphur Spleenwort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
